content.title: Incremental
about: Incremental is an action incremental game where you fight enemies, collect coins, and invest them into a branching skill tree.
The core loop is built around experimentation: combine upgrades, complete challenges to unlock new nodes, and gradually craft stronger builds.
Developed as a longer-term SouthWest Studio project and published on itch.io.
features: Skill tree progression with unlockable branches nodes and synergies
Challenge system that unlocks new upgrades and rewards
Fast top-down combat loop focused on movement, timing, and build choices
learnings: Designing scalable progression systems (skill trees, unlocks, challenges)
Balancing economy curves and difficulty for long-running sessions
Building modular gameplay systems to support future content
Keeping UI readable as complexity grows
